criteria.C1: label-free arm: the median over its three seeds of the median over the 128 held-out members of |S_pred / S_ref - 1| is at most 0.05
criteria.C2: label-free arm: the median over its three seeds of the median over the 128 held-out members of the column-face contact intersection over union is at least 0.9
criteria.incomplete: INCOMPLETE while a label-free seed has neither predictions nor a non-finite stop
criteria.non_finite_seed: a label-free seed whose run stopped on a non-finite loss enters the medians over seeds with |S_pred / S_ref - 1| = infinity and intersection over union = 0
criteria.reported_not_judged: every metric for every arm and seed; the supervised arms against the label-free one, with no winner set in advance; the tested layouts

evaluation.contact_tolerance: u_x <= 1e-3 u_scale on the column face, for prediction and reference alike
metrics: the field rescaled along its ray, alpha = f.u / u.K.u: its stiffness error and energy gap

family.fixed: beam, column flange, bolts and load arm of FS1; E 210000, nu 0.3

map.on: u_x of the column face and the separation slots of the bearing patches

model.decoder: the repository's FieldDecoder (node latent and pooled latent, two GELU layers), last layer zeroed at the start
model.features: centred RMS-normalised coordinates (3), Dirichlet flags (3), load over its largest component (3), node flags (6), family parameters over their range maxima (8)
model.output_scale: label-free displacement scale of the export (u_scale)

training.batch: one instance per step, instances in a fresh random order each epoch
training.energy_loss: energy of the instance over its label-free energy scale (P/2) u_scale / 2
training.non_finite: a non-finite loss stops the run; the stop is final and is not retried
training.precision: float32 weights and activations; float32 matmul precision 'highest' (no TF32)
training.schedule: cosine with linear warm-up over the first 5% of steps (the repository's)
training.supervised_loss: mean squared error of the field in units of u_scale
